patch_description: The SEARCH text did not match because the file already contains a constructor body (a random initialization with `rng = np.random.default_rng(seed=42)`). This edit replaces that naive random initialization with a deterministic multi-start optimizer: several candidate layouts (3-fold symmetric rings, a triangular-lattice pattern, Sobol quasi-random with fixed seed, and one random restart), each refined by a multi-stage stochastic hill-climb that directly maximizes the minimum triangle area normalized by the convex hull area (scale-invariant objective). The final configuration is rescaled so its convex hull has unit area, matching the problem's unit-area normalization. All operations are seeded, so results are deterministic and reproducible.
